project_title: ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር (When Spider Webs Unite)
music_style_prompt: Warm, gentle Ethiopian acoustic instrumental featuring soft krar harp and washint flute melodies, calm reflective lo-fi rhythm, uplifting emotional build, no vocals

characters.dawit: 22-year-old Ethiopian male university student in Addis Ababa, short curly black hair, wearing a clean navy blue knit sweater over a white collared shirt, warm expressive eyes
characters.selam: 22-year-old Ethiopian female university student in Addis Ababa, braided black hair tied neatly back, wearing an ochre yellow cardigan and round eyeglasses, focused and kind expression

shots.narration_amharic: አንድ ቀጭን የሸረሪት ድር በቀላሉ በነፋስ ይበጠሳል።
shots.subtitle_en: A single strand of a spider's web breaks easily in the wind.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme macro cinematic photograph of a single delicate dew-covered spider silk strand glistening in warm morning sunlight in an Addis Ababa garden, shallow depth of field, golden bokeh, 9:16 vertical
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in camera movement as morning breeze softly sways the glistening spider silk strand
shots.music_cue: Soft solo krar plucking, sparse and delicate

shots.narration_amharic: ነገር ግን ብዙ ድሮች አንድ ላይ ሲተሳሰሩ፣ የማይበጠስ ጠንካራ ገመድ ይሆናሉ።
shots.subtitle_en: Yet when many strands weave together, they form an unbreakable cord.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up cinematic shot of an intricate, symmetrical spider web woven across green leaves, golden hour sunlight illuminating the tightly connected threads, warm natural tones, 9:16 vertical
shots.motion_prompt: Slow upward tilt across the woven web catching warm golden sunbeams
shots.music_cue: Gentle washint flute enters softly over krar arpeggio

shots.narration_amharic: በአዲስ አበባ ቤተ መፅሃፍ ውስጥ፣ ዳዊት ከባድ የፕሮግራሚንግ ችግር ለብቻው ለመፍታት ይታገላል።
shots.subtitle_en: Inside a library in Addis Ababa, Dawit struggles alone to solve a difficult coding problem.
shots.image_prompt: Medium vertical shot of Dawit, 22-year-old Ethiopian male student in a navy blue knit sweater, sitting alone at a wooden library desk in Addis Ababa late afternoon, hand on forehead looking tired beside a laptop and open notebooks, warm window light, cinematic realism, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle slow zoom-in toward Dawit looking stressed at his laptop screen
shots.music_cue: Low contemplative bass note, slower hesitant rhythm

shots.narration_amharic: በሌላ ጠረጴዛ ላይ ደግሞ ሰላም ተመሳሳይ ፈተና ገጥሟት በሃሳብ ተውጣለች።
shots.subtitle_en: At another table nearby, Selam faces the exact same challenge, lost in thought.
shots.image_prompt: Medium vertical shot of Selam, 22-year-old Ethiopian female student with braided hair, ochre yellow cardigan, and round eyeglasses, sitting at a separate wooden library table surrounded by math notes and a laptop, looking puzzled, soft warm sunlight, cinematic realism, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle pan from her handwritten notes up to Selam's thoughtful expression
shots.music_cue: Sparse krar melody echoing the feeling of isolation

shots.narration_amharic: ሁለቱም ብቻቸውን ሲሞክሩ ሰዓታት አለፉ፤ መፍትሔው ግን ሩቅ መሰለ።
shots.subtitle_en: Hours passed as both worked alone, and the solution felt out of reach.
shots.image_prompt: Wide vertical interior shot of a quiet sunlit Addis Ababa study hall at dusk, Dawit at a foreground desk and Selam seated across the aisle in the background, warm amber shadows lengthening across wooden tables, cinematic film grain, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Slow horizontal drift showing the distance between the two separate desks
shots.music_cue: Muted percussive pulse building quiet tension

shots.narration_amharic: በመጨረሻም ሰላም ወደ ዳዊት ጠረጴዛ ቀርባ ሀሳቧን ማካፈል ጀመረች።
shots.subtitle_en: Finally, Selam walked over to Dawit's table and began sharing her ideas.
shots.image_prompt: Medium two-shot in a warm Addis Ababa library, Selam in her ochre yellow cardigan and round glasses leaning beside Dawit in his navy blue sweater, pointing kindly at a notebook diagram while Dawit looks up with relief, golden window light, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth slow push-in as both students lean toward the shared notebook
shots.music_cue: Warm chord shift as krar and washint harmonize together

shots.narration_amharic: የዳዊት ትዕግስት እና የሰላም ጥልቅ እውቀት ሲዋሐዱ፣ የተወሳሰበው ችግር በግልጽ ታየ።
shots.subtitle_en: When Dawit's patience and Selam's insight combined, the complex problem became clear.
shots.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder vertical close-up of Dawit in navy blue sweater and Selam in ochre yellow cardigan working side by side at one desk, writing clean logic steps on paper beside a glowing laptop screen showing passing green test checks, warm golden light, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle camera tilt from the handwritten solution up to their smiling faces
shots.music_cue: Uplifting rhythmic groove enters with light traditional percussion

shots.narration_amharic: አባቶቻችን እንደተናገሩት፦ ድር ቢያብር አንበሳ ያስር። ትብብር የማይቻል የሚመስለውን ያስችላል።
shots.subtitle_en: As our elders say: When spider webs unite, they can tie up a lion. Collaboration makes the impossible possible.
shots.image_prompt: Medium vertical portrait of Dawit in navy sweater and Selam in ochre cardigan smiling warmly together outside an Addis Ababa campus courtyard at golden sunset, holding notebooks, vibrant warm light, cinematic depth of field, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Slow confident pull-back revealing the warm golden sunset behind both students
shots.music_cue: Full, warm emotional swell of krar and washint flute

shots.narration_amharic: ዛሬ እውቀትህን ለሌላው አካፍል፤ አብረን ስንቆም ከማንኛውም ፈተና በላይ ጠንካራ ነን።
shots.subtitle_en: Share your knowledge today; when we stand together, we are stronger than any challenge!!.
shots.image_prompt: Symbolic artistic vertical shot of glowing golden threads weaving together into a strong luminous pattern against a deep warm dusk sky over Addis Ababa hills, serene and inspiring, cinematic lighting, 9:16
shots.motion_prompt: Slow upward gaze toward the glowing woven threads in the evening sky
shots.music_cue: Gentle resonant krar finale fading into warm silence
